prompt:
Create an 8-second premium 2D product motion-graphics film for WorkDash, a real browser-based pixel-art social workspace. Landscape 16:9. This is a website preview, with no narration and no music needed.

CRITICAL ASSET FIDELITY: The supplied image IS the real application. Treat it as one immutable raster image layer, a literal screenshot pasted into the composition. Every pixel of its room, furniture, rug, bookshelves, character, face, body, clothing, and the "You" label must retain the same relative position and appearance for the entire film. Do not reinterpret, redraw, animate, morph, turn, bend, walk, wave, sway, twist or add motion inside that screenshot. The character is frozen exactly as photographed. This is motion design AROUND a screenshot, not an animated game scene. Never invent interface controls, messages, menus, new characters, particles inside the app, or features.

ART DIRECTION: High-end editorial software product film. Warm near-black charcoal #1b1815 background, subtle warm ivory hairline frame and a restrained burnt-orange #d8530b accent. Use generous negative space and immaculate smooth easing. All pixels of the source screenshot remain sharp, not blurred. The screenshot stays centered, front-facing, perfectly rectangular with its original 2:1 aspect ratio. No perspective distortion, no 3D room, no rotating camera, no floating furniture. It should occupy roughly 92% of the video width so the real room dominates.

TIMING:
0-1.5s: Start with the real screenshot already visible as a large flat panel on the charcoal canvas. A fine orange segment traces the upper-left edge of its thin frame while the complete screenshot panel gently settles upward by a few pixels.
1.5-5.5s: Extremely slow uniform dolly-in on the whole screenshot panel, only about 4 percent. Add one soft, elegant light sweep to the OUTSIDE frame only. Screenshot interior remains untouched and static.
5.5-8s: Ease the entire panel back to its exact starting framing for a calm seamless loop. Leave time to appreciate the actual pixel-art lounge.

No text titles or wordmarks, no slogan, no captions, no play icon, no CTA, no device mockup, no cursor. Website typography and real clickable CTA are supplied separately by the site. Avoid flashy transitions, bounce, spin, glitch, lens flare and stock advertising templates. The value is disciplined motion design and fidelity to the supplied real application screenshot.
postprocessing: The generated app pixels did not retain full fidelity, so every frame has the entire generated screen interior replaced with the original owner-captured screenshot. The source is uniformly resized and cropped to the moving rectangular aperture; no sprite or room content is synthesized. 192 source frames at 24 fps. The final web clip uses seconds 4 through 8 of the source, then reverses them for a continuous 8-second loop. The narrow opening is omitted so the real room is visible immediately. Silent 1280x720 H.264, CRF 23, faststart. Poster comes from the fully revealed frame at 7.95 seconds. The generated background is graded to the site charcoal before compositing the original app screenshot. The screenshot receives no color grading. Source crop anchor is 35 percent vertically to keep the character label in view during the reveal.
